from io import BytesIO

import pandas as pd
import urllib.request

# Online source workbook
DATA_FILE = (
    "https://catrinharris.github.io/CDR_KI/"
    "App_in_KI_DataCollection.xlsx"
)

# Download the workbook into memory
with urllib.request.urlopen(DATA_FILE) as response:
    workbook_bytes = response.read()

# Open the workbook from memory
excel_file = pd.ExcelFile(BytesIO(workbook_bytes))

# Read the technology sheets, excluding CoverPage and Options
sheet_names = [
    sheet
    for sheet in excel_file.sheet_names
    if sheet not in {"CoverPage", "Options"}
]



dfs = []
add_row_template_dfs = []
for sheet in sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(DATA_FILE, sheet_name=sheet)
    if len(df) > 0:
        # Ignore Excel row 2 (first data row in pandas, index 0) on each technology sheet.
        df = df.drop(index=df.index[0]).reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Find the marker row "Copy variables from the above choice only"
    marker_row = None
    for idx, row in df.iterrows():
        if "Copy variables from the above choice only" in str(row.values):
            marker_row = idx
            break
    
    # Add Row options live above the marker and are tied to the tab technology.
    if marker_row is not None:
        options_df = df.iloc[:marker_row].copy()
    else:
        options_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=df.columns)
    options_df["Technology"] = sheet
    add_row_template_dfs.append(options_df)

    # Data starts from row after marker.
    if marker_row is not None:
        df = df.iloc[marker_row + 1:].reset_index(drop=True)
    
    dfs.append(df)

# Concatenate all sheets and clean up
data = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)
data.columns = data.columns.str.strip()

template_options = pd.concat(add_row_template_dfs, ignore_index=True)


# Validate required schema once so downstream logic can assume stable columns.
required_columns = [
    "Technology",
    "Type",
    "Component",
    "Sub-Component",
    "Variation",
    "Unit",
    "Description",
    "Suggested metadata",
    "Region",
    "Source type",
    "Source",
    "Value",
    "Value estimate",
    "Year",
    "Metadata",
    "Reference or scenario",
    "Entry Author (Affiliation)",
    "Reference DOI/link",
]
missing_columns = [col for col in required_columns if col not in data.columns]
if missing_columns:
    raise ValueError(f"Missing required columns in App_in_KI_DataCollection.xlsx: {missing_columns}")

# Keep app data in reactive state so newly added rows appear immediately.
data_store = reactive.Value(data.copy())

ADD_ROW_OPTION_COLUMNS = [
    "Technology",
    "Type",
    "Component",
    "Sub-Component",
    "Variation",
    "Unit",
    "Region",
    "Source type",
]

SOURCE_TYPE_CHOICES = [
    "IAM parameter",
    "Expert estimate",
    "Case study",
    "Other modelling",
]

VALUE_ESTIMATE_CHOICES = ["Low", "Medium", "High"]

def _clean_option_value(value: object) -> str | None:
    if pd.isna(value):
        return None
    text = str(value).strip()
    if not text or text == "-- None --":
        return None
    return text


TECH_TO_SHEET_NAME = {
    cleaned: original
    for original in sheet_names
    if (cleaned := _clean_option_value(original)) is not None
}


def _build_options_sheet_lookup() -> dict[str, dict[str, str | None]]:
    if "Options" not in excel_file.sheet_names:
        return {}

    options_df = pd.read_excel(DATA_FILE, sheet_name="Options")
    if len(options_df) > 1:
        options_df = options_df.drop(index=options_df.index[1]).reset_index(drop=True)
    options_df.columns = [str(col).strip() for col in options_df.columns]

    def _find_column(*keywords: str) -> str | None:
        for col in options_df.columns:
            normalized = str(col).strip().lower().replace(" ", "")
            if all(keyword in normalized for keyword in keywords):
                return col
        return None

    technology_col = _find_column("technology", "list")
    option_col = _find_column("option", "list")
    additional_col = _find_column("additional")

    lookup: dict[str, dict[str, str | None]] = {}
    for _, row in options_df.iterrows():
        technology_name = _clean_option_value(row.get("Technology"))
        if technology_name is None:
            continue

        lookup[technology_name] = {
            "component": _clean_option_value(row.get(technology_col)) if technology_col else None,
            "sub_component": _clean_option_value(row.get(option_col)) if option_col else None,
            "variation": _clean_option_value(row.get(additional_col)) if additional_col else None,
        }

    return lookup


OPTIONS_SHEET_LOOKUP = _build_options_sheet_lookup()


def _normalize_add_row_option_df(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = df.copy()
    df.columns = [str(col).strip() for col in df.columns]

    for _, row in df.iterrows():
        technology_name = _clean_option_value(row.get("Technology"))
        if technology_name is None or technology_name not in OPTIONS_SHEET_LOOKUP:
            continue

        replacements = OPTIONS_SHEET_LOOKUP[technology_name]
        for col_name in ["Component", "Sub-Component", "Variation"]:
            if col_name not in df.columns:
                continue
            value = row.get(col_name)
            if pd.isna(value):
                continue
            text = str(value).strip()
            normalized = text.lower().replace(" ", "")
            replacement = None
            if normalized == "[technologylist]":
                replacement = replacements.get("component")
            elif normalized == "[optionlist]":
                replacement = replacements.get("sub_component")
            elif normalized == "[additional]":
                replacement = replacements.get("variation")
            if replacement is not None:
                df.at[_, col_name] = replacement

    cols_present = [col for col in ADD_ROW_OPTION_COLUMNS if col in df.columns]
    option_df = df[cols_present].copy() if cols_present else pd.DataFrame()

    for col in cols_present:
        option_df[col] = option_df[col].map(_clean_option_value)

    for col in ADD_ROW_OPTION_COLUMNS:
        if col not in option_df.columns:
            option_df[col] = pd.NA

    option_df = option_df[ADD_ROW_OPTION_COLUMNS]

    # Keep rows that hold real values in other columns (e.g., Type) and only clear placeholder cells.
    for col in ["Component", "Sub-Component", "Variation"]:
        if col not in option_df.columns:
            continue
        value_norm = option_df[col].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
        placeholder_mask = value_norm.str.contains(
            r"\[technology\s*list\]|\[option\s*list\]|\[additional\]",
            regex=True,
            na=False,
        )
        option_df.loc[placeholder_mask, col] = pd.NA

    # Some tabs include an embedded header row above the marker; remove it.
    header_mask = pd.Series(False, index=option_df.index)
    for col in ADD_ROW_OPTION_COLUMNS:
        col_name_norm = col.strip().lower()
        value_norm = option_df[col].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
        header_mask = header_mask | (value_norm == col_name_norm)
    option_df = option_df[~header_mask]

    option_df = option_df.dropna(how="all")
    return option_df


def _build_sheet_technology_options_df() -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for technology_name in sheet_names:
        cleaned_name = _clean_option_value(technology_name)
        if cleaned_name is None:
            continue
        row = {col: pd.NA for col in ADD_ROW_OPTION_COLUMNS}
        row["Technology"] = cleaned_name
        rows.append(row)

    if not rows:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=ADD_ROW_OPTION_COLUMNS)
    return pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=ADD_ROW_OPTION_COLUMNS)


def _build_options_sheet_add_row_df() -> pd.DataFrame:
    if "Options" not in excel_file.sheet_names:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=ADD_ROW_OPTION_COLUMNS)

    options_df = pd.read_excel(DATA_FILE, sheet_name="Options")
    if len(options_df) > 1:
        options_df = options_df.drop(index=options_df.index[1]).reset_index(drop=True)
    options_df.columns = [str(col).strip() for col in options_df.columns]

    def _find_column(*keywords: str) -> str | None:
        for col in options_df.columns:
            normalized = str(col).strip().lower().replace(" ", "")
            if all(keyword in normalized for keyword in keywords):
                return col
        return None

    technology_col = _find_column("technology", "list")
    option_col = _find_column("option", "list")
    additional_col = _find_column("additional")

    rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for _, row in options_df.iterrows():
        technology_name = _clean_option_value(row.get("Technology"))
        if technology_name is None:
            continue

        if technology_col:
            tech_list_value = _clean_option_value(row.get(technology_col))
            if tech_list_value is not None:
                option_row = {col: pd.NA for col in ADD_ROW_OPTION_COLUMNS}
                option_row["Technology"] = technology_name
                option_row["Component"] = tech_list_value
                rows.append(option_row)

        if option_col:
            option_list_value = _clean_option_value(row.get(option_col))
            if option_list_value is not None:
                option_row = {col: pd.NA for col in ADD_ROW_OPTION_COLUMNS}
                option_row["Technology"] = technology_name
                option_row["Sub-Component"] = option_list_value
                rows.append(option_row)

        if additional_col:
            additional_value = _clean_option_value(row.get(additional_col))
            if additional_value is not None:
                option_row = {col: pd.NA for col in ADD_ROW_OPTION_COLUMNS}
                option_row["Technology"] = technology_name
                option_row["Variation"] = additional_value
                rows.append(option_row)

    if not rows:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=ADD_ROW_OPTION_COLUMNS)
    return _normalize_add_row_option_df(pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=ADD_ROW_OPTION_COLUMNS))


ADD_ROW_STATIC_OPTIONS = (
    pd.concat(
        [
            _normalize_add_row_option_df(template_options),
            _build_sheet_technology_options_df(),
            _build_options_sheet_add_row_df(),

        ignore_index=True,
    )
    .drop_duplicates()
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

def select_choices(column_name: str) -> list[str]:
    values = sorted(data[column_name].dropna().astype(str).unique().tolist())
    return ["All"] + values

def dropdown_choices(column_name: str) -> list[str]:
    return sorted(data[column_name].dropna().astype(str).unique().tolist())


def add_row_static_choices(column_name: str) -> list[str]:
    values = (
        ADD_ROW_STATIC_OPTIONS[column_name]
        .dropna()
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
        .replace("", pd.NA)
        .dropna()
        .unique()
        .tolist()
    )
    return sorted(values)

def compute_parameter_unit(row):
    """Compute parameter (unit) as: Region Component Sub-Component Type - Variation (Unit)"""
    region = str(row.get("Region", "")).strip()
    component = str(row.get("Component", "")).strip()
    sub_component = str(row.get("Sub-Component", "")).strip()
    type_val = str(row.get("Type", "")).strip()
    variation = str(row.get("Variation", "")).strip()
    unit = str(row.get("Unit", "")).strip()
    
    parts = [region, component, sub_component, type_val]
    if variation:
        parts.append(f"- {variation}")
    
    param_str = " ".join(p for p in parts if p)
    if unit:
        param_str += f" ({unit})"
    
    return param_str


data["Parameter (unit)"] = data.apply(compute_parameter_unit, axis=1)

# Country and region-name normalization helpers used during map resolution.
def _country_name_to_iso3(name: str) -> str | None:
    """Convert a country name to ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, with fuzzy fallback."""
    key = name.strip().lower()
    if key in COUNTRY_NAME_OVERRIDES:
        return COUNTRY_NAME_OVERRIDES[key]
    try:
        return pycountry.countries.lookup(name).alpha_3
    except LookupError:
        pass
    try:
        results = pycountry.countries.search_fuzzy(name)
        if results:
            return results[0].alpha_3
    except LookupError:
        pass
    return None


def _load_iam_region_mappings() -> dict[str, dict[str, list[str]]]:
    # Pull model-native region definitions from IAM YAML files on GitHub.
    """Fetch all native-region YAML files from the IAMconsortium/common-definitions
    GitHub repository.
    Returns: {model_name (lowercase) -> {bare_region_name (lowercase) -> [ISO3 list]}}
    Falls back to an empty dict if the network is unavailable.
    """
    tree_url = (
        "https://api.github.com/repos/IAMconsortium/common-definitions"
        "/git/trees/main?recursive=1"
    )
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(tree_url, headers={"Accept": "application/vnd.github+json"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:
            tree = json.loads(resp.read())
        yaml_paths = [
            item["path"]
            for item in tree.get("tree", [])
            if item["path"].startswith("definitions/region/native_regions/")
            and item["path"].endswith(".yaml")
            and item["type"] == "blob"
        ]
    except Exception:
        yaml_paths = []

    base_raw = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IAMconsortium/common-definitions/main/"
    # model_name_lower -> {bare_region_lower -> [iso3_list]}
    by_model: dict[str, dict[str, list[str]]] = {}

    for path in yaml_paths:
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(base_raw + path, timeout=10) as resp:
                data = yaml.safe_load(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
        except Exception:
            continue

        if not isinstance(data, list):
            continue
        for model_block in data:
            if not isinstance(model_block, dict):
                continue
            for model_name, regions in model_block.items():
                if not isinstance(regions, list):
                    continue
                model_key = model_name.strip().lower()
                region_map_for_model = by_model.setdefault(model_key, {})
                for region_block in regions:
                    if not isinstance(region_block, dict):
                        continue
                    for full_key, region_data in region_block.items():
                        bare = full_key.split("|", 1)[1].strip() if "|" in full_key else full_key.strip()
                        if not isinstance(region_data, dict):
                            continue
                        countries_val = region_data.get("countries")
                        if countries_val is None:
                            continue
                        if isinstance(countries_val, str):
                            countries_val = [countries_val]
                        iso3_list = [
                            iso for c in countries_val
                            if (iso := _country_name_to_iso3(str(c))) is not None
                        ]
                        if iso3_list:
                            region_map_for_model[bare.lower()] = iso3_list
    return by_model


# Loaded once at startup: {model_name_lower -> {bare_region_lower -> [ISO3]}}
IAM_REGION_MAPPINGS: dict[str, dict[str, list[str]]] = _load_iam_region_mappings()


# Resolve each Region/Source pair into one or more ISO3 locations for plotting.
def _resolve_region_to_iso3s(
    region: str,
    source: str,
    iso3_lower: dict[str, str],
) -> list[str] | None:
    """Resolve a region value to a list of ISO3 codes.
    1. Try as a single country (returns a one-element list).
    2. Match source to a model, look up in that model's regions.
    3. Fall back: search all models for the region name.
    Returns None if nothing matched.
    """
    def _clean(s: str) -> str:
        return re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", "", s).strip().lower()

    cleaned = _clean(region)

    # --- Step 1: try as a single country ---
    iso = iso3_lower.get(cleaned)
    if not iso:
        try:
            iso = pycountry.countries.lookup(region.strip()).alpha_3
        except LookupError:
            pass
    if not iso:
        try:
            results = pycountry.countries.search_fuzzy(region.strip())
            if results:
                iso = results[0].alpha_3
        except LookupError:
            pass
    if iso:
        return [iso]

    # --- Step 2: source-matched model ---
    src_lower = source.strip().lower()
    for model_key, regions in IAM_REGION_MAPPINGS.items():
        if model_key in src_lower or src_lower in model_key:
            iso_list = regions.get(cleaned)
            if iso_list:
                return iso_list

    # --- Step 3: fallback — any model ---
    for regions in IAM_REGION_MAPPINGS.values():
        iso_list = regions.get(cleaned)
        if iso_list:
            return iso_list

    return None

def server(input, output, session):
    add_row_message = reactive.Value("")
    next_id_counter = reactive.Value(1)

    @output
    @render.text
    def next_id_display():
        return str(next_id_counter.get())


    def _required_field_values() -> dict[str, str]:
        return {
            "Technology": input.new_technology(),
            "Type": input.new_type(),
            "Component": input.new_component(),
            "Region": input.new_region().strip(),
            "Source type": input.new_source_type(),
            "Source": input.new_source().strip(),
            "Value": input.new_value().strip(),
            "Unit": input.new_unit().strip(),
            "Value estimate": input.new_value_type().strip(),
            "Metadata": input.new_metadata().strip(),
            "Reference or scenario": input.new_ref().strip(),
            "Entry Author": input.new_entry_author().strip(),

    # Central reactive slice used by tables, summary cards, and the map.
    @reactive.Calc
    def filtered_data():
        df = data_store.get().copy()

        filter_map = [
            ("Technology", input.technology_filter()),
            ("Type", input.type_filter()),
            ("Component", input.component_filter()),
            ("Sub-Component", input.sub_component_filter()),
            ("Variation", input.variation_filter()),
            ("Region", input.region_filter()),
            ("Source type", input.source_type_filter()),
            ("Source", input.source_filter()),
        ]

        for column_name, selected_value in filter_map:
            if selected_value != "All":
                df = df[df[column_name].astype(str) == selected_value]

        return df

    def _add_row_option_source() -> pd.DataFrame:
        dynamic_options = _normalize_add_row_option_df(data_store.get().copy())
        return (
            pd.concat([dynamic_options, ADD_ROW_STATIC_OPTIONS], ignore_index=True)
            .drop_duplicates()
            .reset_index(drop=True)
        )

    def _cascaded_choices(filters: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> list[str]:
        """Return sorted unique values of the last filter's column, constrained by all prior filters."""
        df = _add_row_option_source()
        for col, val in filters[:-1]:
            if val:
                df = df[df[col].astype(str) == val]
        col_name = filters[-1][0]
        values = sorted(df[col_name].dropna().astype(str).unique().tolist())

        if values:
            return values

        # Fallback: if a strict chain has no match, keep the field usable.
        fallback_df = _add_row_option_source()
        return sorted(fallback_df[col_name].dropna().astype(str).unique().tolist())

    def _update_add_row_select(input_id: str, choices: list[str], current_value: str, none_allowed: bool = False):
        base_choices = ["-- None --"] + choices if none_allowed else choices
        if not base_choices:
            base_choices = ["-- None --"] if none_allowed else [""]
        default = "-- None --" if none_allowed else base_choices[0]
        selected = current_value if current_value in base_choices else default
        ui.update_select(input_id, choices=base_choices, selected=selected, session=session)

    def _sidebar_choices(filters: list[tuple[str, str]], target_col: str) -> list[str]:
        """Return sidebar filter choices for target_col constrained by upstream sidebar selections."""
        df = data_store.get().copy()
        for col, val in filters:
            if val != "All":
                df = df[df[col].astype(str) == val]
        values = sorted(df[target_col].dropna().astype(str).unique().tolist())
        return ["All"] + values

    def _update_sidebar_select(input_id: str, choices: list[str], current_value: str):
        selected = current_value if current_value in choices else "All"
        ui.update_select(input_id, choices=choices, selected=selected, session=session)

    # Keep dependent select inputs cascaded so choices stay context-aware.
    @reactive.Effect
    def _cascade_sidebar_type_filter():
        choices = _sidebar_choices(
            [("Technology", input.technology_filter())],
            "Type",
        )
        _update_sidebar_select("type_filter", choices, input.type_filter())

    @reactive.Effect
    def _cascade_type():

            ("Type", ""),
        ])

    @reactive.Effect

            ("Component", ""),
        ])

    @reactive.Effect
    def _cascade_sub_component():

            ("Type", input.new_type()),
            ("Component", input.new_component()),
            ("Sub-Component", ""),
        ])
        _update_add_row_select("new_sub_component", choices, input.new_sub_component(), none_allowed=True)

    @reactive.Effect
    def _cascade_variation():
        sub_component_value = "" if input.new_sub_component() == "-- None --" else input.new_sub_component()
        choices = _cascaded_choices([
            ("Technology", input.new_technology()),
            ("Type", input.new_type()),

        _update_add_row_select("new_variation", choices, input.new_variation(), none_allowed=True)

    @reactive.Effect
    def _cascade_unit():
        sub_component_value = "" if input.new_sub_component() == "-- None --" else input.new_sub_component()
        variation_value = "" if input.new_variation() == "-- None --" else input.new_variation()
        choices = _cascaded_choices([
            ("Technology", input.new_technology()),
            ("Type", input.new_type()),
            ("Component", input.new_component()),
            ("Sub-Component", sub_component_value),
            ("Variation", variation_value),
            ("Unit", ""),
        ])
        if len(choices) == 1:
            unit_value = choices[0]
        elif input.new_unit() in choices:
            unit_value = input.new_unit()
        else:
            unit_value = ""
        ui.update_text("new_unit", value=unit_value, session=session)

    # Persist newly entered rows to Excel and refresh the in-memory dataset.
    @reactive.Effect
    @reactive.event(input.add_row)
    def _add_row():
        current_df = data_store.get().copy()

        required = _required_field_values()
        missing = [label for label, val in required.items() if not val]
        if missing:
            add_row_message.set(f"Please fill in: {', '.join(missing)}")
            return

        current_id = next_id_counter.get()
        col_map = {
            "Technology": input.new_technology(),
            "Type": input.new_type(),
            "Component": input.new_component(),
            "Sub-Component": (input.new_sub_component() if input.new_sub_component() != "-- None --" else ""),
            "Variation": (input.new_variation() if input.new_variation() != "-- None --" else ""),
            "Unit": input.new_unit().strip(),
            "Description": "",
            "Suggested metadata": "",
            "Region": input.new_region().strip(),
            "Source type": input.new_source_type(),
            "Source": input.new_source().strip(),
            "Value": input.new_value().strip(),
            "Value estimate": input.new_value_type().strip(),
            "Year": input.new_year().strip(),
            "Metadata": input.new_metadata().strip(),
            "Reference or scenario": input.new_ref().strip(),
            "Entry Author (Affiliation)": input.new_entry_author().strip(),
            "Reference DOI/link": input.new_doi().strip(),
        }
        new_row = {col: (col_map.get(col, "") if col_map.get(col, "") != "" else pd.NA) for col in current_df.columns}
        new_row["Parameter (unit)"] = compute_parameter_unit(new_row)

        updated_df = pd.concat([current_df, pd.DataFrame([new_row])], ignore_index=True)

        try:
            selected_technology = _clean_option_value(input.new_technology())
            if not selected_technology:
                add_row_message.set("Technology is required.")
                return

            target_sheet_name = TECH_TO_SHEET_NAME.get(selected_technology)
            if not target_sheet_name:
                add_row_message.set(
                    f"Could not match technology '{selected_technology}' to an Excel tab."
                )
                return

            target_sheet_df = pd.read_excel(DATA_FILE, sheet_name=target_sheet_name)

            marker_row = None
            for idx, row in target_sheet_df.iterrows():
                if "Copy variables from the above choice only" in str(row.values):
                    marker_row = idx
                    break

            if marker_row is None:
                add_row_message.set(
                    f"Could not find marker row in sheet '{target_sheet_name}'."
                )
                return

            data_part = target_sheet_df.iloc[marker_row + 1:].copy()

            if not data_part.empty:
                has_data_mask = data_part.apply(
                    lambda r: r.map(lambda v: pd.notna(v) and str(v).strip() != "").any(),
                    axis=1,
                )
                if has_data_mask.any():
                    last_data_idx = has_data_mask[has_data_mask].index.max()
                    data_part = data_part.loc[:last_data_idx].copy()
                else:
                    data_part = data_part.iloc[0:0].copy()

            normalized_sheet_cols = {
                str(col).strip(): col for col in target_sheet_df.columns
            }
            sheet_row = {col: pd.NA for col in target_sheet_df.columns}
            for col_name, value in col_map.items():
                sheet_col_name = normalized_sheet_cols.get(col_name)
                if sheet_col_name is not None:
                    sheet_row[sheet_col_name] = value if value != "" else pd.NA
            new_sheet_row_df = pd.DataFrame([sheet_row])

            header_and_template = target_sheet_df.iloc[: marker_row + 1].copy()
            updated_sheet_df = pd.concat(
                [header_and_template, data_part, new_sheet_row_df],
                ignore_index=True,
            )

            shutil.copy2(DATA_FILE, BACKUP_FILE)
            with pd.ExcelWriter(
                DATA_FILE,
                engine="openpyxl",
                mode="a",
                if_sheet_exists="replace",
            ) as writer:
                updated_sheet_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=target_sheet_name, index=False)
        except Exception as exc:
            add_row_message.set(f"Could not save row to Excel file: {exc}")
            return

        data_store.set(updated_df)
        next_id_counter.set(current_id + 1)
        add_row_message.set(
            f"Row {current_id} added successfully to sheet '{target_sheet_name}' and saved to App_in_KI_DataCollection.xlsx."
        )

        for inp_id in [
            "new_source",
            "new_value",
            "new_unit",
            "new_value_type",
            "new_year",
            "new_metadata",
            "new_ref",
            "new_doi",
            "new_entry_author",
            "new_region",
        ]:
            if inp_id in [
                "new_source",
                "new_value",
                "new_year",
                "new_metadata",
                "new_ref",
                "new_doi",
                "new_entry_author",
            ]:
                ui.update_text(inp_id, value="", session=session)

        ui.update_text("new_unit", value="", session=session)
        ui.update_text("new_region", value="", session=session)

        ui.update_select("new_value_type", selected="Medium", session=session)

    # Renderers for summary metrics, data grid, and geographic coverage map.
    @output
    @render.ui
    def summary():
        df = filtered_data()
        num_records = len(df)
        source_type_series = df["Source type"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
        expert_count = int(source_type_series.str.contains("expert", na=False).sum())
        iam_count = int(source_type_series.str.contains("iam", na=False).sum())
        counts_line = f"Expert values: {expert_count} | IAM values: {iam_count}"
        parameter_options = sorted(
            df["Parameter (unit)"].dropna().astype(str).str.strip().replace("", pd.NA).dropna().unique().tolist()
        )

        if len(parameter_options) == 1:
            selected_param_name = parameter_options[0]
            unit_match = re.search(r'\(([^)]+)\)\s*$', selected_param_name)
            unit_suffix = f" {unit_match.group(1)}" if unit_match else ""

            #source_type_series = df["Source type"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
            #expert_count = int(source_type_series.str.contains("expert", na=False).sum())
            #iam_count = int(source_type_series.str.contains("iam", na=False).sum())
            parameter_line = f"{selected_param_name}"
            #counts_line = f"Expert values: {expert_count} | IAM values: {iam_count}"

            avg_mask = df["Value estimate"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == "medium"
            avg_numeric = pd.to_numeric(df.loc[avg_mask, "Value"], errors="coerce")
            mean_value = avg_numeric.mean()
            mean_value_text = f"{mean_value:.3f}{unit_suffix}" if pd.notna(mean_value) else "N/A"
            avg_min, avg_max = avg_numeric.min(), avg_numeric.max()
            if pd.notna(avg_min) and pd.notna(avg_max):
                range_line = f"{avg_min:.3f}{unit_suffix} \u2013 {avg_max:.3f}{unit_suffix}"
            else:
                range_line = "N/A"
            mean_line = f"Mean value: {mean_value_text}"

            all_numeric = pd.to_numeric(df["Value"], errors="coerce")
            uc_min, uc_max = all_numeric.min(), all_numeric.max()
            if pd.notna(uc_min) and pd.notna(uc_max):
                uc_range_line = f"{uc_min:.3f}{unit_suffix} \u2013 {uc_max:.3f}{unit_suffix}"
            else:
                uc_range_line = "N/A"
        else:
            all_filters_set = all(
                selected != "All"
                for selected in [
                    input.technology_filter(),
                    input.type_filter(),
                    input.component_filter(),
                    input.sub_component_filter(),
                    input.variation_filter(),
                    input.region_filter(),
                    input.source_type_filter(),
                    input.source_filter(),
                ]
            )
            if all_filters_set:
                derived_parts = [
                    str(input.region_filter()).strip(),
                    str(input.component_filter()).strip(),
                    str(input.sub_component_filter()).strip(),
                    str(input.type_filter()).strip(),
                ]
                variation = str(input.variation_filter()).strip()
                if variation:
                    derived_parts.append(f"- {variation}")
                derived_name = " ".join(part for part in derived_parts if part)
                unit_values = sorted(
                    df["Unit"].dropna().astype(str).str.strip().replace("", pd.NA).dropna().unique().tolist()
                )
                if len(unit_values) == 1:
                    derived_name += f" ({unit_values[0]})"
                parameter_line = derived_name if derived_name else " "
            else:
                parameter_line = " "

            #counts_line = "Expert: N/A | IAM: N/A"
            #mean_line = "Narrow filters to one Parameter to view"
            #range_line = "Narrow filters to one Parameter to view"
            #uc_range_line = "Narrow filters to one Parameter to view"

            mean_line = "Select filters until one parameter remains"
            range_line = "Select filters until one parameter remains"
            uc_range_line = "Select filters until one parameter remains"

        def _stat_box(title, value):
            return ui.div(
                ui.div(title, style="font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #6b7280; margin-bottom: 0.3rem;"),
                ui.div(value, style="font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 500; color: #111827;"),
                style=(
                    "flex: 1; min-width: 0; "
                    "background: #ffffff; "
                    "border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; "
                    "border-radius: 8px; "
                    "padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem; "
                    "text-align: center;"
                ),
            )

        # Strip label prefix so box values contain only the data
        mean_val = mean_line.split(": ", 1)[1] if ": " in mean_line else mean_line
        range_val = range_line.split("): ", 1)[1] if "): " in range_line else range_line
        uc_val = uc_range_line.split(": ", 1)[1] if ": " in uc_range_line else uc_range_line
        expert_val = counts_line

        return ui.div(
            ui.div(
                ui.strong(parameter_line),
                style="font-size: 1rem; margin-bottom: 0.6rem; color: #374151; text-align: center; width: 100%;",
            ),
            ui.div(
                _stat_box("Total Records", str(num_records)),
                _stat_box("Mean Value", mean_val),
                _stat_box("Medium Data Range", range_val),
                _stat_box("Uncertainty Range", uc_val),
                _stat_box("Source Types", expert_val),
                style="display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap;",
            ),
            style="margin-bottom: 0.9rem;",
        )

    @output
    @render.data_frame
    def data_table():
        df = filtered_data().copy()

        # Display-only cleanup: hide Suggested metadata and show Parameter (unit) first.
        if "Suggested metadata" in df.columns:
            df = df.drop(columns=["Suggested metadata"])
        if "Parameter (unit)" in df.columns:
            ordered_cols = ["Parameter (unit)"] + [c for c in df.columns if c != "Parameter (unit)"]
            df = df[ordered_cols]

        if "Description" in df.columns and "Metadata" in df.columns:
            display_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c != "Description"]
            metadata_idx = display_cols.index("Metadata")
            display_cols.insert(metadata_idx, "Description")
            df = df[display_cols]

        if "Value" in df.columns and "Unit" in df.columns:
            display_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c != "Unit"]
            value_idx = display_cols.index("Value")
            display_cols.insert(value_idx + 1, "Unit")
            df = df[display_cols]

        styles = []

        if "Parameter (unit)" in df.columns:
            parameter_col_idx = df.columns.get_loc("Parameter (unit)")
            styles.append(
                {
                    "cols": [parameter_col_idx],
                    "style": {
                        "color": "#6b6b6b",
                        "min-width": "320px",
                        "width": "320px",
                    },
                }
            )

        wide_text_cols = [
            col_idx
            for col_name in ["Description", "Metadata"]
            if col_name in df.columns
            for col_idx in [df.columns.get_loc(col_name)]
        ]
        if wide_text_cols:
            styles.append(
                {
                    "cols": wide_text_cols,
                    "style": {
                        "min-width": "320px",
                        "width": "320px",
                    },
                }
            )

        if "Reference DOI/link" in df.columns:
            doi_col_idx = df.columns.get_loc("Reference DOI/link")
            styles.append(
                {
                    "cols": [doi_col_idx],
                    "style": {
                        "min-width": "640px",
                        "width": "640px",
                    },
                }
            )

        return render.DataGrid(df, styles=styles)

    @output
    @render.data_frame
    def technology_summary_table():
        df = filtered_data().copy()
        df["Technology"] = df["Technology"].fillna("Unknown").astype(str)
        source_type = df["Source type"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
        df["_is_iam"] = source_type.str.contains("iam", na=False)
        df["_is_expert"] = source_type.str.contains("expert", na=False)

        summary_df = (
            df.groupby("Technology", dropna=False)
            .agg(
                Entries=("Technology", "size"),
                **{
                    "IAM count": ("_is_iam", "sum"),
                    "Expert count": ("_is_expert", "sum"),
                },
            )
            .reset_index()
            .sort_values("Entries", ascending=False)
        )
        return render.DataGrid(summary_df, selection_mode="none")

    @output
    @render_widget
    def region_map():
        from collections import defaultdict

        _alias_lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in REGION_ALIASES.items()}
        _iso3_lower = COUNTRY_NAME_OVERRIDES

        def _clean(name: str) -> str:
            return re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", "", name).strip().lower()

        def _apply_alias(name: str) -> str:
            return _alias_lower.get(_clean(name), name)

        # Work row-by-row so we can use both Region and Source
        df_rows = filtered_data()[["Region", "Source"]].copy()
        df_rows["Region"] = df_rows["Region"].dropna().astype(str).str.strip()
        df_rows = df_rows[df_rows["Region"].notna() & (df_rows["Region"] != "")]
        df_rows["Region"] = df_rows["Region"].map(_apply_alias)
        df_rows["Source"] = df_rows["Source"].fillna("").astype(str)

        if df_rows.empty:
            empty_df = pd.DataFrame({"Region": ["No data"], "Entries": [0]})
            fig = px.choropleth(
                empty_df,
                locations="Region",
                locationmode="country names",
                color="Entries",
                title="No region data available",
            )
            fig.update_layout(height=520, margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=50, b=0))
            return fig

        global_mask = df_rows["Region"].map(_clean).str.contains("global", na=False)
        global_count = int(global_mask.sum())

        iso_to_name = {
            c.alpha_3: c.name
            for c in pycountry.countries
            if getattr(c, "alpha_3", None) and c.alpha_3 != "ATA"
        }

        country_entry_counts: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
        for _, row in df_rows[~global_mask].iterrows():
            iso3s = _resolve_region_to_iso3s(row["Region"], row["Source"], _iso3_lower)
            if iso3s:
                for iso in iso3s:
                    country_entry_counts[iso] += 1

        specific_counts = (
            pd.DataFrame(list(country_entry_counts.items()), columns=["iso_alpha", "Entries"])
            if country_entry_counts
            else pd.DataFrame(columns=["iso_alpha", "Entries"])
        )

        if global_count > 0:
            # Baseline of global_count on every country so the map matches the total entry count.
            all_iso = pd.DataFrame({"iso_alpha": sorted(iso_to_name.keys())})
            region_counts = all_iso.merge(specific_counts, on="iso_alpha", how="left")
            region_counts["Entries"] = region_counts["Entries"].fillna(0).astype(int) + global_count
        else:
            region_counts = specific_counts.copy()

        if region_counts.empty:
            empty_df = pd.DataFrame({"Region": ["No data"], "Entries": [0]})
            fig = px.choropleth(
                empty_df,
                locations="Region",
                locationmode="country names",
                color="Entries",
                title="No region data available",
            )
            fig.update_layout(height=520, margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=50, b=0))
            return fig

        max_entries = int(region_counts["Entries"].max())
        half_entries = max_entries / 2
        region_counts["Region"] = region_counts["iso_alpha"].map(iso_to_name).fillna(region_counts["iso_alpha"])

        fig = px.choropleth(
            region_counts,
            locations="iso_alpha",
            locationmode="ISO-3",
            color="Entries",
            hover_name="Region",
            color_continuous_scale=[
                [0.0, "#ffffff"],
                [0.05, "#eef5fc"],
                [0.2, "#cfe3f6"],
                [0.45, "#6fa8dc"],
                [0.75, "#2b7bba"],
                [1.0, "#0b3c78"],
            ],
            projection="natural earth",
            title="Regions with Data Entries",
        )
        fig.update_geos(
            showcoastlines=True,
            showcountries=True,
            showframe=False,
            showland=True,
            landcolor="white",
            bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
            lataxis_range=[-58, 90],
        )
        fig.update_coloraxes(
            cmin=0,
            cmax=max_entries,
            colorbar=dict(
                tickmode="array",
                tickvals=[0, half_entries, max_entries],
                ticktext=["0", f"{half_entries:g}", str(max_entries)],
                title="Entries",
                x=0.73,
                xanchor="left",
                y=0.5,
                yanchor="middle",
                len=0.82,
            ),
        )
        fig.update_layout(
            height=520,
            margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=50, b=0),
            geo=dict(domain=dict(x=[0.0, 0.70], y=[0.0, 1.0])),
        )
        return fig

    @output
    @render.download(filename="filtered_data.csv")
    def download_data():
        yield filtered_data().to_csv(index=False)

# Create the app
app = App(app_ui, server)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run(reload=True)
